map_info.name: PRIM RhizomeWorld
map_info.description: A test at world scale: the rhizome at 4x, 143.7 m across, on an open plain. Walk around it, find the mouth, walk through it.

metadata.design_notes: A TEST, and the thing being tested is scale. The same body that fits in a 34 m room is here at 4x: 143.7 m across the diagonal, chambers you could put a museum hall inside, passages ten metres wide. It costs exactly what the small one costs — 620,242 triangles — because it is the same mesh scaled rather than a rebuild, and the cell has become a one-metre facet. You arrive on the approach line with the mouth already in front of you and a hundred metres of body behind it. The plain is empty on purpose: at this size the body is the landscape, and anything else on the floor would be arguing with it.
